summary: Re-run required by consult-backed-parking-2026-10-12#D-021 after the WI-6554700010009740 fix changed apps/operator/scripts/psu-pty-host.mjs (87b4114a -> 93cb45ea). On staging :3170 (build b01fcd34c9, which carries both pinned blobs), one fresh tracked source session per backend (claude adv 42167, codex adv 42168, omp adv 42169) replied with its MATRIX-SRC token and was stopped. Each source was then resumed onto both other backends with psu --resume --agent. disclosures: Staging only. Production :3070 serves main d740fc3802, which does not carry these launcher fixes, and the ~/.local/bin/psu shim resolves the release launcher unless PAPERCUSP_PSU_LAUNCHER is set. An owner's bare `psu --resume` gets this behaviour once green main carries it.

Pairs ran three at a time (phase A: claude->codex, codex->omp, omp->claude; phase B: claude->omp, codex->claude, omp->codex), each concurrent pair from a distinct source identity, not strictly one pair at a time. Phase B started only after the phase-A targets were stopped.

The claude->codex target launcher (adv 42173) was SIGKILLed (exit 137) at 05:35:42Z, about 2 minutes AFTER its port was delivered and persistence-verified; the sender is unrecorded. Filed as WI-6554700010009850. The reconciler closed row 42173 at 05:42:12Z.
The codex source (adv 42168) ended by signal at 05:29:48Z, 13s after launch, after replying MATRIX-SRC cbp13r2-codex-5c07; it was resumable as a source in both phases.

The seed check is independent of the launcher's own persistenceProof: it greps the target's native transcript file for the literal 'port-id: <port id>' line. Codex transcript ingest into session_turn_parts was reported wedged during this run, so the database ingest table was NOT used as the oracle.
Native transcript paths are abbreviated: <repo-project-dir> stands for the per-cwd project directory name the backend derives from the canonical tree path.
Written via capability:bash under an explicit locks:acquire hold (lock 89e2313f) because the PreToolUse lock hook denies Write while :3070 lacks the native operation protocol (EI-25836734668397073).
